findings.message: src/components/Glossary.tsx renders `children ?? term`, so the nine self-closing tags in the Urdu pages print English words ("Pakistan Studies", "Ideology", "Ideology of Pakistan", "National identity", "Two-Nation Theory", "Sovereignty", "Objectives Resolution", "Theocracy", "Quaid-e-Azam") as the grammatical subject of Urdu sentences, and the Urdu term itself never appears (e.g. topic-01 L73 reads "Ideology اس بارے میں ..."). Locators: topic-01.mdx L34, L73 (2), L75; topic-02.mdx L34, L66, L73, L84, L90. Repair: give each tag Urdu children, e.g. <Glossary term="Theocracy">مذہبی پیشوائی کی حکومت</Glossary>, as other Urdu units do.

topic-02.mdx L40: EN contrasts "a fully independent country" with "a large self-governing Muslim unit within India"; UR renders the second as "خود مختار مسلم خطہ", and خود مختار commonly means independent/sovereign, which collapses the very distinction historians debate. Repair: e.g. "ہندوستان کے اندر ایک بڑا، اندرونی طور پر خود انتظامی مسلم خطہ".

Grammar errors visible to readers: "مجموعی جائزہ کا کام" (topic-01 L145, topic-02 L153; oblique should be "مجموعی جائزے کا کام"); "یونٹ 1 کی مجموعی جائزہ" (unit-assessment L3 description; جائزہ is masculine: "یونٹ 1 کا مجموعی جائزہ"); "قوم اور اس کا وطن کا حق" (topic-02 L115 table; should be "قوم اور اس کے وطن کا حق").

EN "The Ideology of Pakistan draws on Islam" becomes "پاکستان کے نظریے کی بنیاد اسلام سے لی جاتی ہے" ("its foundation is taken from Islam") at topic-01 L81 and L132, unit-assessment L22, and RRQ 2 model L152. That is stronger than the English and sits awkwardly in the passage that corrects the belief that the ideology "just means Islam". Repair: e.g. "پاکستان کا نظریہ اسلام سے رہنمائی لیتا ہے".

"civics" (the subject area) is rendered "شہریت", which means citizenship: topic-01 L36, L57, L116, L132, fig-U1-1/fig-U1-2 labels and alt text, unit-assessment L22 and RRQ 1 model L150. The term is not in the frozen bank. Proposed for owner ruling: "شہریات" or "علمِ شہریت" (the school subject name). Not changing the bank.

The frozen bank pairs "Pakistan Studies" = "پاکستان کے مطالعہ" and "Ideology of Pakistan" = "پاکستان کے نظریے" are oblique-case fragments. Inside a phrase they work ("پاکستان کے مطالعہ کا مضمون"), but as standalone nouns they read as ungrammatical: key_terms in index.mdx, the centre label of fig-U1-1.ur.svg ("پاکستان کے مطالعہ"), the title of fig-U1-2.ur.svg ("جماعت میں پاکستان کے مطالعہ"), the trunk of fig-U1-4.ur.svg ("پاکستان کے نظریے"), and fig-U1-1 alt ("مرکز میں پاکستان کے مطالعہ ہے"). The translator correctly followed the bank. Owner ruling requested on whether to adopt the established forms "مطالعۂ پاکستان" and "نظریۂ پاکستان" (or nominative "پاکستان کا مطالعہ").
